entities.name: Mature Plantation Society — 'Little England'
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Barbados developed the most densely settled and intensively cultivated plantation system in the Caribbean. The white planter elite created an elaborate British-style society, earning the island its 'Little England' nickname. By the 1780s, enslaved people outnumbered free residents four to one.
